ticker_notes.AAPL: 預期FY27銷售2000萬臺對比街預期1000萬，供應緊張但一月改善，計劃大增產

zh_summary: 關於 $AAPL Duo 明日發布的最終想法。由於供應噪音，不要對明日解讀過多。仍預期 FY27 將銷售 2000 萬臺，而街預期約 1000 萬臺。猜測每間店會有一打在手。交貨期仍顯示一月底，與上週不變。今日供應極度緊張，但一月將大幅改善。他們迅速將預售推至一月底並維持，這表明計劃大規模增產。
en_summary: Final thought going into Duo’s launch tomorrow for $AAPL. Don’t read too much into tomorrow because of supply noise. Still expects they’ll sell 20M units in FY27 vs. Street at around 10M. Guess each store will have a dozen on hand. Lead times still showing late January, unchanged from last week. Supply is crazy tight today, but in January it will be much better. They quickly pushed preorders to late January and have held there, which tells a big ramp is planned.
text:
Final thought going into Duo’s launch tomorrow. Don’t read too much into tomorrow because of supply noise. I still expect they’ll sell 20M units in FY27 vs. Street at around 10M.

My guess is each store will have a dozen on hand. I’ll be at a store to confirm.Lead times still showing late January, unchanged from last week.

If it’s true that each store only gets a handful, many investors will discount the positive read on long online lead times over the past week, attributing them to tight supply.

My read is supply is crazy tight today, but in January it will be much better. They quickly pushed preorders to late January and have held there, which tells me a big ramp is planned. $AAPL
